derivation: from a derivative of the base of G5168 (τρυμαλιά);
def: an aperture, i.e. a needle's eye

occurrences.text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
